claim: runInstall (and install.sh) install the presentation profile only after runSyncs/sync_skills.sh ran, so a fresh casual install takes sync_skills' developer branch, writes no skillOverrides and no routine overlay, and every smine skill stays visible until some later re-sync — contrary to correctness-49.
fix: Move installPresentationProfile(repoDir, presentationProfileId) before runSyncs in runInstall, and the profile cp block before the sync_skills call in install.sh, keeping the missing-template error fatal.

claim: The nightly stage-3 additionalDirectories append (run.sh L302-308) is erased every orchestrated night: /smine-orchestrate (L318) runs sync_settings.sh, whose sync_file copies the template (additionalDirectories empty) over ~/.claude/settings.json, so the next night's stage 1 runs without --repos — contrary to correctness-60 (append, never remove).
fix: Make sync_settings.sh carry the live permissions.additionalDirectories (and skillOverrides) into the deployed settings via a jq merge instead of a plain cp, or at minimum run the wrapper's append after the orchestrate stage returns.

claim: classViolations exempts a changed rule by its WORKING lifetime, so a branch that appends lifetime="task" to a protected doctrine rule's marker gets zero CheckPolicy diagnostics in gated and strict mode, and the default doctrine-only check stops running the rule — a branch can switch off any protected gate, contradicting CheckPolicy's 'a branch cannot weaken the mode'.
fix: Exempt task-lifetime rules only when the base side holds no doctrine rule with that id: pass base rule lifetimes into classViolations and skip the exemption when the base rule is doctrine; add a policy_test case that demotes ACDSL-PLAN-100 with lifetime="task" (gated and strict).

claim: The claude 'apply overrides' direction copies the live settings.json verbatim over the repo fragment, replacing the {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} marker spec-13 introduced with this install's literal port; marker handling exists only on revert and compare paths.
fix: On apply (live->fragment) for the claude target, collapse expanded install values back to their markers before writing (a config.CollapseInstallMarkers in internal/config/installenv.go restoring {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT), mirroring the revert-side ExpandInstallMarkers.

claim: install.sh writes PEEK_*_HOME unquoted into install.env, which install.sh and sync_settings.sh source under set -e; a home path containing a space parses as a command and aborts the install and every later settings sync.
fix: Write install.env values shell-quoted (printf '%s=%q\n') in install.sh, or parse KEY=VALUE lines instead of sourcing the file in install.sh and sync_settings.sh.

claim: spec-6 requires GitRevParse's error to carry git's stderr, but it runs rev-parse --verify --quiet and wraps only shell.Run's exit error, discarding the output.
fix: Drop --quiet and fold shell.Run's output into the error (fmt.Errorf("GitRevParse: %s: %s: %w", ref, strings.TrimSpace(output), err)), or delete the helper, which has no non-test caller.

claim: The new casual lockout reads ~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md while the unchanged Safety rule forbids any read outside the worktree; an agent honoring Safety never learns the audience and the casual gate fails open.
fix: Amend the Safety bullet to name the presentation profile as the one sanctioned read-only access outside the worktree, or have run.sh pass the audience in the apply prompt suffix.

claim: The --no-batch cursor takes the minimum across five ledgers including analyzed-permissions.txt, which no pre-existing folder holds; the missing-ledger fallback resolves to the oldest batch, so after upgrade --no-batch re-routes batch 01 instead of the next unrouted batch.
fix: Exclude a not-yet-existing dimension ledger from the --no-batch cursor minimum (or seed analyzed-permissions.txt from the other ledgers' first line) so the new dimension starts at the current cursor.

claim: handleProfileSave's audience-change branch (skills-sync lock, skills.Sync, 409 on held lock, 500 on failed sync) has no observable test; deleting the whole if audienceChanged block keeps the suite green.
fix: Make writeStubSyncScripts record invocations in a marker file and add cases: audience change -> sync ran once; no change -> no sync; stub exit 1 -> 500; held skillsSyncLockKey -> 409.

claim: acdsl-policy-guard matches the protected surface by literal prefix of the unnormalized path and resolves the policy root from cwd, so ./acdsl/policy.json, x/../acdsl/policy.json, ACDSL/policy.json (case-insensitive APFS) and writes from a session rooted in another repo pass with no deny.
fix: Canonicalize before matching: resolve the target dir with cd -P on the nearest existing ancestor of dirname(abs), walk up for acdsl/policy.json from that dir instead of cwd, and compare a lower-cased rel against lower-cased patterns.

claim: The Bash rule derivation Bash(<program> <subcommand> *) has no exec-wrapper exclusion, so two sessions granting bash -c '<x>' yield a proposed Bash(bash -c *) arbitrary-execution allow rule, contradicting the skill's own 'never a rule broader than the evidence'.
fix: Treat exec-wrapper programs (bash/sh -c, node -e, perl/ruby -e, env, xargs, eval, find -exec) as non-generalizable in step 2 — propose only the exact granted line or drop with a run-report line — and make step 3 drop any wildcard candidate covering an ask/deny entry's program family.

claim: The rewritten session-mine section says Drift skips sessions/proposals/ while session-mine.js skips archived/, and its args line omits since/last/dev/subagents/maxMinedTotal/maxMinedPerDimension.
fix: Say the Drift stage scans every folder under sessions/ except archived/, and add since/last/dev/subagents/maxMinedTotal/maxMinedPerDimension to the args line.

claim: CheckPolicy's free-mode escape for an unresolvable base (policy.go:331-334) has no test; deleting the guard keeps the suite green while acdsl check in a repo with no resolvable base and no policy.json would exit 2.
fix: Add TestCheckPolicyFreeWithoutBase: git init -b trunk, commit, absent policy.json (or Policy{Mode: PolicyModeFree, BaseRef: "nosuchref"}) -> CheckPolicy returns nil diagnostics and nil error.

claim: shell.RunSync has no test in internal/shell; its 10-minute deadline and RunSync: error prefix are never asserted.
fix: Add TestRunSync mirroring TestRunDialog (passthrough; failing script returns output and an error containing "RunSync") plus an assertion that SyncTimeout is 10*time.Minute.

claim: writePolicy's fallback (source policy without dist_mode ships its own mode) is never exercised; the only shipping test uses the real policy.json with dist_mode=gated.
fix: Add a dist_test case: synthetic root with acdsl/policy.json {"mode": "strict"} (no dist_mode) -> writePolicy returns PolicyModeStrict and LoadPolicy(dest).Mode == PolicyModeStrict.

claim: TestReposDelete lacks spec-14's cross-instance case (repo stays deleted after a second NewRegistry on the same repos.json writes); covered only at the registry layer.
fix: Add a TestReposDelete case: POST /repos/delete demo, then repos.NewRegistry(reposPath)+Add of another repo, assert repos.json and GET /repos no longer hold demo.

claim: The Load->LoadFragment switches in claudeRows, hooksFragmentDiff and renderPermissions have no marker test; reverting any of them keeps the suite green while /config/claude would flag the env row overridden on every install.
fix: Extend TestConfigOverriddenPage with a {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} marker fragment plus install.env and expanded live env -> env row not overridden; same shape for the hooks and permissions pages.

claim: filter_untracked's any-depth .DS_Store exclusion is never exercised: both droppings tests write only a top-level .DS_Store, already matched by the older pattern.
fix: Add a tracked subdir to the droppings fixtures in test_remove_agent_worktrees.sh and test_print_agent_worktrees_status.sh, write $wt/sub/.DS_Store, and assert removal still succeeds and UNTRACKED is unchanged.

claim: test_squash_transfer_reads_contained asserts only grep -q 'squashed:' while spec-11 names squashed:2, and the fixture actually yields applied:1,squashed:1 — the count is neither asserted nor as specified.
fix: Assert the exact VERDICTS cell for the squash fixture ($9 == "applied:1,squashed:1") and correct spec-11's Tests/Verification rows from squashed:2 to applied:1,squashed:1.

claim: The bootstrap wrapper's --repos roster from settings.json additionalDirectories (with .git filter) is never exercised; the fake HOME has no settings.json.
fix: Add a test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh case with $fake_home/.claude/settings.json additionalDirectories [git dir, plain dir] asserting the mine DRY line carries --repos <name>=<git dir> and omits the plain dir.

claim: The if condition at policy.go:315 holds two && operators.
fix: Bind the compound condition to a named predicate (isUnchanged := existedAtBase && existsNow && string(raw) == baseContent) and test that.

claim: Three classViolations calls (372-374) pass five arguments on one line.
fix: Split each five-argument classViolations call one argument per line, or bind the result to a variable before the append.

claim: New policy.go function signatures are not sorted alphabetically after ctx (9 sites).
fix: Sort the parameters after ctx alphabetically in all nine flagged signatures (classViolations, basePolicy, effectiveAllowlist, policyDiagnostic, surfaceDelta, overlayViolations, policyBase, ruleDelta, CheckPolicy) and update their callers.

claim: "acdsl/policy.json" and "acdsl/registry.json" repeat as bare literals without named constants.
fix: Add named constants for "acdsl/policy.json" and "acdsl/registry.json" next to LocalRegistryName and use them in policySurface, basePolicy and effectiveAllowlist.

claim: Unexported installEnvValues follows exported ExpandInstallMarkers in a new file.
fix: Move installEnvValues above ExpandInstallMarkers.

claim: New shellGitAbbrevRef sorts before the preceding shellGitGrepCached in the unexported function group.
fix: Move shellGitAbbrevRef above shellGitGrepCached.

claim: New const labelMaxLength is declared after var namePattern.
fix: Declare const labelMaxLength = 80 before var namePattern.

claim: Constant-literal nestedRunPattern is compiled inside a function on every call, unlike every other first-party regexp.
fix: Move nestedRunPattern to a package-level var nestedRunPattern = regexp.MustCompile(...).

claim: Bool config field Policy.AllowTaskContracts is not named Is<X>Active.
fix: Rename Policy.AllowTaskContracts to IsTaskContractExemptionActive, keeping the json tag allow_task_contracts.

claim: testCase booleans _taskExempt and absent do not read as predicates.
fix: Rename them to _isTaskExempt and isAbsent.

claim: New bools Routine.DefaultDisabled/Unscheduled and scheduleInfo.Supported/Unscheduled are not predicate-named.
fix: Rename them to Is-prefixed predicates and update all readers, including internal/server handlers and templates.

claim: Task-state literals NotFound and Disabled repeat across sched_windows.go without named constants.
fix: Declare taskStateNotFound/taskStateDisabled/taskStateRunning constants and use them in taskState, IsLoaded, IsRunning and SyncAll.

claim: Registry.save errors use the bare "save:" prefix instead of "Registry.save:".
fix: Change the four save: error prefixes in Registry.save to Registry.save:.

claim: New Archive/Delete scope tests script several error branches sequentially in one body without a testCase table.
fix: Convert the Archive/Delete/Unarchive scope tests to testCase tables with one t.Run per branch, and move the ArchivedFolders asserts into their own test.

claim: The peek SessionIndex probe uses an inline 5*time.Second while the package names this bound probeTimeout.
fix: Use probeTimeout (welcome.go:33) in context.WithTimeout at bootstrap.go:152, or name a bootstrap-specific const if 5s is deliberate.

claim: Default bootstrap lookback hard-coded as AddDate(0, 0, -30).
fix: Declare const bootstrapSinceDefaultDays = 30 in welcome.go's const block and use now.AddDate(0, 0, -bootstrapSinceDefaultDays).

claim: DefaultStylePath repeats DefaultPresentationPath's home lookup and .claude/context/global join verbatim.
fix: Extract globalContextPath(name string) string and have DefaultPresentationPath/DefaultStylePath call it.

claim: The three new archive/delete/unarchive handlers repeat one opResult + store op + HX-Redirect + render body.
fix: Add renderScopeOp(w, subject, redirect string, err error) that fills opResult, sets HX-Redirect and renders; the three handlers call it with their store op's error (fold in the known HX-Redirect-on-failure fix at the same time).

claim: The skills-sync failure error lacks the Component.Method: prefix.
fix: fmt.Errorf("handleProfileSave: Profile saved, but the skills sync failed: %w", err).

claim: proposalViews (181) and groupViews (203) calls pass six arguments on one line.
fix: Break both calls one argument per line with trailing commas, binding the nested calls to locals first.

claim: bootstrapRun.running and bootstrapView.Running are not predicate-named.
fix: Rename to isRunning/IsRunning, along with the status local, welcome_test.go:236 and the template's .Running.

claim: Four testCase literals omit the asserted meta field _expectedDevMode.
fix: Add _expectedDevMode: false to the case literals at 59, 75, 125 and 141.

claim: The new peek stop-listener loop copies the configserver lsof/kill/kill -0 poll block.
fix: Fold configserver and peek ports into one stop loop (for port in "$ADDR_PORT" "$PEEK_PORT" "$PEEK_CONTROL_PORT") or extract stop_listener <port>, deleting the duplicate block.

claim: The marker-expansion sed is duplicated in sync_file (61) and merge_mcp_servers (114); the diff added the same expression to both.
fix: Extract expand_markers() holding the three -e marker expressions and call it from both sites.

claim: skill-invoke-gate.sh copies read-gate.sh's exact-cat tokenizer and guide-membership loop verbatim.
fix: Move exact_cat_target and the guide-path membership test into one sourced helper (cmd/hooks/hooklib.sh) and call it from both hooks.

claim: Both new squash tests inline the identical agent-step/merge --squash fixture.
fix: Extract build_squashed_branch <repo> <branch> (mirroring build_resolved_branch) and call it from both squash tests.

claim: The orchestrate command substitution re-does cd "$repo_root" although cwd is already $repo_root since line 272.
fix: Drop the redundant cd "$repo_root" && in the orchestrate command substitution.

claim: The header still says 'Two stages' and never mentions the new orchestrate stage.
fix: Update the header to list mine, consolidate, apply, publish and the casual-gated orchestrate stage.

claim: The new candidates digest re-filters for-each-ref with its own claude(-routines)? regex after load_candidates already filled candidates[].
fix: Compute WTS_CANDIDATES_DIGEST from the loaded candidates[] (name + rev-parse per entry) instead of re-filtering for-each-ref.

claim: PROPOSAL_DIMENSIONS equals DIMENSIONS, so its .has(name) conjunct at L137 is always true (dead filter).
fix: Delete PROPOSAL_DIMENSIONS and reduce the L137 condition to maxMinedPerDimension > 0.

claim: The new workflow names the retired fchange skill ('fchange/fdesign plan') at L3/L60/L87.
fix: Replace 'fchange/fdesign plan' with 'fdesign plan (new or change route)' in L3, L60, L87 and the fdesign 3.7 changelog text.

claim: meta.whenToUse lists 7 args keys while the script's contract has 13.
fix: List the full args contract in meta.whenToUse (add maxMinedPerDimension?, maxMinedTotal?, since?, last?, dev?, agents?).

claim: The new 'Never translate' sentences enumerate 8-10 items inline, past the 6-item cap.
fix: Render each new 'Never translate' list (smine-batch, -context, -memory, -skills, -routines, -permissions, -consolidate) as sub-bullets or one shared table.

claim: CTX-002 names its enforcing hooks inline under [review] with no Hook: pointer bullet.
fix: Retag CTX-002 to a hook channel, keep the statement behavioral, and move skill-invoke-gate/read-gate into a * Hook: bullet.

claim: fdesign changelog 3.7 (2026-08-22) sits above 3.6 (2026-08-27), breaking newest-first date order.
fix: Date 3.7 with its landing date (on or after 2026-08-27).

claim: package-commit changelog 3.3 (2026-08-22) sits above 3.2 (2026-08-23).
fix: Date 3.3 with its landing date (on or after 2026-08-23).

claim: smine-apply changelog 1.26 (2026-08-20) sits above 1.25 (2026-08-23).
fix: Date 1.26 with its landing date (on or after 2026-08-23).
Date 1.12 and 1.13 with their landing dates (on or after 2026-08-23), 1.13 not older than 1.12.

claim: Concept audit: the routine default-disabled marker, Unscheduled state, RunResult.Result/Subtype with History's started-row filter (and further go-core concepts) trace to none of the 14 supplied specs.
fix: none
